from.place: Definition-only extraction of the four comparison predicates needed in the quotient theorem and its chart dependency.

title: Canonical coefficient, open-base and free-model comparison predicates
statement: For the canonical symmetric graded algebra of a quasi-coherent module E on S and a normalized tautological quotient datum D [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data], define: IsCanonicalMap by the existence on every framed affine source of a scalar-compatible ring map with the quotient generator coefficients, unit irrelevant-ideal image, and the corresponding Proj.fromOfGlobalSections equation; HasOpenCompatibility by the open-base fibre-product square and quotient-preserving line comparison; AffineFreeComparison by the ordered-basis polynomial Proj isomorphism and shifted-module twist comparison; HasFreeCompatibility by the relative-projective-space model and all affine polynomial comparisons. These are predicates only and assert no existence theorem. The definitions are moved verbatim from the quotient-geometry module.
